qualification_scope: Protocol, initialization, recorded CUPTI coverage, and captured payload consistency; not a physical-path certification.

evidence.path_note: Logical relative labels only: result.log is the supplied log; payloads/ is the supplied payload directory.

limitations: A same-index sentinel match does not prove absence of writes; the same value could have been written.
The source hash is bijective over uint32; an in-range inverse is only an equality hypothesis about the source index.
Source and sentinel matches at other indices are independent and may overlap.
Repeated blocks, especially uniform blocks, do not prove addressing aliasing.
SHA256 records the bytes analyzed; it does not authenticate their origin.
Word patterns alone cannot locate a fault in a requester, mapping, bridge, or host fabric.
Recorded CUPTI per-case coverage is cross-checked here; callback/correlation reconstruction is a separate audit.
CUPTI does not expose final hardware transfer descriptors or exclude every possible internal staging path.
PUSH and PULL still use separate allocations and virtual mappings; this is not a same-allocation A/B test.
A complete diagnostic run, including 24 passing payloads if observed, is not by itself a certified P2P fix.

overlapping_value_counts.note: These counts overlap with the three mutually exclusive word classes.
